Filter velocity AnnData using PARSE DGE output and add metadata

Source: R/parse.R
HORIZON_parse_DGE_filter.Rd

Takes the raw adata_vel.h5ad from HORIZON_run_parse_velocity and filters it to the cells and genes present in the split-pipe DGE output (typically DGE_filtered), then adds cell and gene metadata from cell_metadata.csv and all_genes.csv.

Usage

HORIZON_parse_DGE_filter(
  velocity_h5ad,
  dge_dir,
  conda_env,
  output_file = NULL,
  force = FALSE
)

Arguments

velocity_h5ad

Character. Path to the raw adata_vel.h5ad produced by HORIZON_run_parse_velocity.

dge_dir

Character. Path to the split-pipe DGE directory (e.g. "<output_dir>/combined/all-sample/DGE_filtered"). Must contain cell_metadata.csv and all_genes.csv.

conda_env

Character. Path to the conda environment used for HORIZON_run_parse_velocity.

output_file

Character or NULL. Output path for the filtered h5ad. Defaults to adata_vel_filtered.h5ad in the same directory as velocity_h5ad.

force

Logical. Reprocess even if output_file already exists.

Value

Character. Path to the filtered h5ad, invisibly.
